prompt: Black's queen is loose. Can you grab it?
note: The queen on h4 is hanging — take it with the knight.

prompt: Something valuable is unprotected. Spot it.
note: The queen on d5 is unprotected — knight takes.

prompt: White left a piece loose. What's hanging?
note: Bishop takes on f2 — the king and rook don't cover it well enough for free.

prompt: Scholar pressure — crash through on f7.
note: Bxf7+ or Qxf7 are the classic beginner crashing ideas on f7.

prompt: Central pawn hang? Capture if it's free.
note: exd5 wins a center pawn.

prompt: Classic beginner fork. Hit two birds.
note: Bishop to f7 checks the king and eyes the rook/queen patterns — scholar-style pressure.

prompt: Develop and threaten. Find a strong knight jump later — here take space with Nxe5 if tactically sound.
note: Knight takes e5 — if Black is careless the knight can fork next.

prompt: Develop toward the center. Best developing move?
note: Develop a bishop; set up future forks and pins.

prompt: Knights love outposts. Jump into a juicy square.
note: Knight into e5 or b5 creates dual threats.

prompt: Queen is centralized and soft. Kick or take?
note: Knight takes the queen — free lunch.

prompt: Pin the knight to the queen.
note: Bg5 pins the knight — a classic developing pin once d3 is played.

prompt: Castle or pin? Find the pin on the knight.
note: Bg5 pins Nf6 to the queen.

prompt: Your queen is under fire. Don't hang it — retreat safely.
note: Move the queen off the loose square.

prompt: Pin Black's knight before they castle.
note: Bg5 is the natural pin; castling is also solid.

prompt: Back-rank mate. Finish it.
note: Re8# — classic back-rank mate.

prompt: Your back rank is soft. Create luft or trade.
note: Make an escape square or challenge the rook.

prompt: Exploit the back rank.
note: Ra8# if the rook is undefended — check the geometry.

prompt: Is there a back-rank shot?
note: Re8+ forces issues on the back rank.

prompt: Scholar's mate is on. Finish it.
note: Qxf7# ends the game immediately — classic scholar's mate.

prompt: Mate in one. Find it.
note: Queen to e8 is checkmate on the open back rank.

prompt: Punish the weakened king diagonal.
note: Qh4# — Fool's mate pattern.

prompt: Two rooks vs lonely king — mate now.
note: Ladder mate on the 8th rank.

prompt: Early queen excursion. Kick it or develop.
note: Don't panic — develop and the queen will lose tempi.

prompt: King and rook endgame basics — capture the hanging rook?
note: King takes the unprotected rook.

prompt: Is the bishop on c4 hanging? Decide.
note: It's defended by ideas later; develop instead of grabbing ghosts.

prompt: Center tension. Capture or push?
note: Resolve the center thoughtfully.

prompt: White pushed d4. Capture correctly.
note: exd4 is the standard reply.

prompt: Italian Game — pin or castle?
note: Bg5 pin or castle are both fine beginner plans.

prompt: Black's knight sat on e4. Is it safe?
note: dxe4 wins the knight if unsupported.

prompt: Queen checks from h4. Block or capture ideas?
note: Block with a piece; don't hang material answering the check.

prompt: Find a forceful knight leap.
note: Nb5 or Ne5 creates dual threats on c7/d7 complexes.

prompt: Black made luft. Is back-rank still on?
note: With g6 played, e8 is not mate — trade or improve instead.

prompt: Centralized queen again. Capture if free.
note: Take the queen if it's hanging.

prompt: Queen's Gambit structure — develop with a pin idea.
note: Bg5 pins Nf6 in many QG lines.

prompt: Queen and king vs king — force mate ideas.
note: Shrink the box; don't stalemate.

prompt: Symmetrical center. Develop before grabbing.
note: c4 challenges the d5 pawn the right way.

prompt: Castle or hit the center?
note: Castle is safest; don't leave the king in the center.

prompt: Queen on h4 looks scary. Is it hanging?
note: Nxh4 wins the queen if unprotected.

prompt: White threatens the back rank. Defend.
note: Take the rook or make luft.

prompt: Continue developing toward an outpost.
note: Develop bishops; look for Ne5 later.

prompt: Both bishops eye f2/f7. Castle first?
note: Castle before tactics get wild.

prompt: Scholar's mate threat on f7. Stop it.
note: Nf6 or Qe7 defends f7.
